name: Pack Shape
body:
You and your animal companion form a pack of wolves.

Prerequisite: Wild shape class feature, wolf animal companion.

Benefit: When you wild shape into a wolf, you are joined by 1d3 additional wolves as though you had cast summon nature’s ally II.
